message: With Workouts on under Settings › Apple Health › Log to Health, your Apple Watch now measures a workout while you log it there: your heart rate shows on the set and rest screens, and the watch saves the workout to Health with its heart rate and active energy. A workout's page on your iPhone shows its average and maximum heart rate and the minutes spent in five zones. The zones use the maximum heart rate you set in Settings › Apple Health › Workouts, or 220 minus your age from the year of birth in the calorie budget, and say which. If you allowed Health access before heart rate was added, tap Health access in Settings to share it.
